notes.title: The new version of bomb22222.0 is updated
notes.notes:
The update content of 2.0 is as follows
Interface update
The interface has been adjusted
Added kill tips
Added icons for some buttons

Sound update
music was updated
Player is defeated sound effect, monster is defeated sound effect
Added pass and fail sound effects

Added features
Added multi-language settings (players can configure more languages ​​by themselves)
Added more settings
Added custom button settings
Added custom mouse speed
Added custom emoji settings
Added shop system
After the player clears the level, the items in the current level will be retained

gameplay increases
Added online battle mode
Added online team battle mode
Added cooperative clearance mode (passed levels are counted as single-player passes)

Prop additions and adjustments
Added high-explosive rounds (can penetrate walls, but with a longer delay)
Added coins (can go to the store to exchange items)
Some props need to pass some levels to appear in stand-alone mode

level increase
Added the second level, 2-1, 2-2, 2-3

enemy increase
The second major level adds new enemies (types are soldiers, hostile to monsters)

Enemy skill adjustment
Different types of enemies now have different skills or special abilities

Difficulty adjustment
Now most monsters don't kill players in seconds (faster monsters do less damage)


Now you can connect to the new version with your friends ːsteamhappyː
